remote_sources.title: Oyenza public map bundle
findings: Building vector tiles use source bld and source-layer buildings, with height/min_height and fallback height 5 m.
bld-3d is a fill-extrusion layer; height interpolates from 0 at zoom 14.5 to attribute height at 15.5; opacity 0.92 and vertical gradient.
set3D uses pitch 56, current bearing or -17, minimum zoom 15.4, and reduced-motion-aware transition.
Map limits include maxPitch 65, maxZoom 18.6, and device pixel ratio cap 2.
Bus custom layer uses renderingMode 2d; this does not establish that bus meshes are 3D.
Ln/Vr are reused minified symbols. In the transit map factory they concern user location and building visibility, not evidence of CCTV frustum geometry.
